name: elegant
label: Elegant
css: .style-elegant { background-color: var(--slide-surface, #FFFFFF); font-family: 'Google Sans', sans-serif; position: relative; width: 1080px; height: 1080px; padding: 64px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden; } .style-elegant::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.03) 0%, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.02) 100%); pointer-events: none; } .style-elegant .hook { font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); margin: 0; letter-spacing: -1.5px; position: relative; z-index: 1; max-width: 90%; } .style-elegant .text { font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); margin: 32px 0 0 0; position: relative; z-index: 1; max-width: 85%; } .style-elegant .step { font-size: 160px; font-weight: 100; line-height: 1; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); opacity: 0.08; position: absolute; top: 32px; right: 32px; z-index: 0; letter-spacing: -4px; } .style-elegant .brand { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); position: absolute; bottom: 32px; left: 32px; z-index: 1; letter-spacing: 0.5px; } .slide-code.style-elegant { background-color: #1a1a1a; background-image: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f172a 0%, #111827 50%, #1a1a2e 100%); color: #e5e7eb; } .slide-code.style-elegant .hook { color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3); } .slide-code.style-elegant .text { color: #d1d5db; } .slide-code.style-elegant .step { color: #4b5563; opacity: 0.12; } .slide-code.style-elegant .brand { color: #9ca3af; } .slide-code.style-elegant::before { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1) 0%, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.05) 100%); } .slide-insight.style-elegant { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #111827 0%, #0f172a 100%); } .slide-insight.style-elegant .hook { color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); } .slide-insight.style-elegant .text { color: #f3f4f6; } .slide-insight.style-elegant .insight-text { font-size: 48px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; color: #ffffff; margin: 24px 0; position: relative; z-index: 1; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6) 0%, var(--slide-secondary, #8B5CF6) 100%); -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; background-clip: text; text-shadow: none; } .slide-insight.style-elegant .step { color: #374151; opacity: 0.15; } .slide-insight.style-elegant .brand { color: #d1d5db; } .slide-insight.style-elegant::before { background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 50%, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15) 0%, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.08) 50%, transparent 100%); }
